title: two drain tasks in transit main.rs share identical 80-line pipeline body
description: transit/src/main.rs has two nearly-identical closures (ingestion_handle ~lines 728-811, staging_drain_opt ~lines 847-951): both call run_pipeline, both notify IPNS, both execute the same remote_pin_jobs INSERT OR IGNORE SQL. Every new post-ingestion step must be added twice. The two have already diverged in subtle ways. Maintenance consequence: pipeline enhancement requires two parallel edits that will drift.
